title: Handle
subtitle: 「處理／應付／管理」，要先分清是在一般處理事情、應付困難、解決問題、監督流程，還是按程序辦理文件與申請。
description: 「處理／應付／管理」，要先分清是在一般處理事情、應付困難、解決問題、監督流程，還是按程序辦理文件與申請。

words.example: She manages several projects at the same time.

exercises.original: She handles several projects at the same time.
exercises.zh: 她同時管理數個項目。
exercises.upgrade: She manages several projects at the same time.

options.explanation: several ongoing projects require organisation and continuing responsibility, so manage is precise。
solve applies to problems with solutions, not ongoing projects。
touch/use are wrong senses of handle。
fix implies repair。
respond to only means react, not organise the projects.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: He handles a heavy workload without missing deadlines.
exercises.zh: 他應付繁重工作量而不會錯過期限。
exercises.upgrade: He manages a heavy workload without missing deadlines.

options.explanation: workload + deadlines points to successful organisation and control。
touch/use are physical-use senses。
fix/solve require a discrete problem。
respond to is too reactive and does not capture ongoing workload control.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The department handles its budget carefully.

exercises.upgrade: The department manages its budget carefully.

options.explanation: budget oversight is a classic manage collocation。
solve/fix do not apply to a budget as ongoing responsibility。
touch is irrelevant。
use only means spend/employ, not manage overall。
respond to is not the right relationship.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

falseSynonyms.zh: 解決不等於所有 handle solve 表示找到答案／解決方案；handle 只表示處理，不保證已解決。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Handling a problem does not necessarily solve it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 控制不等於 handle control 強調支配、限制或保持在掌握中；handle 可以只是應付。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Control is stronger and more restrictive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 使用不等於抽象 handle handle 有時可指操作物件，但在『處理問題』sense 中 use 不是同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Use applies to employing something, not dealing with a problem.

falseSynonyms.zh: 觸摸不等於 handle handle 作物理動詞可有拿取／操作意思，但 touch 只表示接觸。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Touching something is not the same as handling it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 修好不等於所有 handle fix 表示修復／解決；handle 不保證問題已修好。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fix implies a successful repair or solution.

falseSynonyms.zh: cope with 只在困難／壓力 sense 接近 handle cope with 強調艱難情況下撐得住。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cope with is difficulty-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: manage 與 handle 很接近，但更常帶持續管理／組織意味 manage 可涉及長期責任、資源或人員。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Manage often implies ongoing control or organisation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 handle 可作動詞或名詞；handling 可表示處理方式或搬運。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Handle can be a verb or noun; handling is the -ing form or a noun.
